# ghost/starke-verben

Starke Verben (F-Droid): learn German strong verbs. Read lessons, look up any verb with all its forms, and take fill-in tests. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/starke-verben
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/starke-verben open_verbs --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/starke-verben next_lesson --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/starke-verben get_lesson --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/starke-verben get_verb --device <serial> --param verb=<verb>
ghost skill run ghost/starke-verben start_test --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/starke-verben answer_test --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/starke-verben finish_test --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_verbs`: Open the Starke Verben app
- `next_lesson`: Show me another German strong verb
- `get_lesson`: What verb is in the current lesson?
- `get_verb`: What are the forms of the German verb essen?
- `start_test`: Start a German strong verb test
- `answer_test`: Answer the German verb test with preterite fuhr
- `finish_test`: Finish the German verb test
